types.name: Background Rates (Type 1)
types.info: The background rate cohort identification strategy identifies prevalent or incident use of an event of interest (i.e., exposure to a medical product or occurrence of an HOI) during the user-defined query period

types.name: Exposure and Follow-Up Time (Type 2)
types.info: The exposures and follow-up time cohort creation strategy defines episodes of new use of a medical product of interest and evaluates the occurrence of health outcomes of interest (HOIs)

types.name: Self-Controlled Risk Interval Design (Type 3)
types.info: The self-controlled risk interval (SCRI) design cohort identification strategy defines new use of a medical product of interest, identifies a risk and control window relative to exposure, and examines the occurrence of Health Outcomes of Interest (HOIs)

types.name: Pregnancy Episodes and Medical Product Use (Type 4)
types.info: The pregnancy episodes cohort identification strategy is used to create a pregnant cohort and identify new use of a medical product of interest and evaluates the occurrence of health outcomes of interest (HOIs) in mothers or infants

types.name: Medical Product Utilization (Type 5)
types.info: The medical product utilization cohort identification strategy is used to characterize patterns of drug use. This strategy creates episodes of medical product exposure and outputs metrics characterizing patient use and dispensing patterns

types.name: Manufacturer-Level Product Utilization and Switching Patterns (Type 6)
types.info: The manufacturer-level product utilization and switching patterns cohort identification strategy is used to characterize patterns of drug use at the manufacturer-level

input_files.name: Cohort File

parameters.info: Identifier for each monitoring period

parameters.name: Index End Date
parameters.info: Last day a patient can contribute an index date to the analysis. Users have the option to explicitly set the date in this field or use INDENDOPTIONS for a data driven approach to set the date.

parameters.name: Index End Date Options
parameters.info: Options for setting the last day a patient can contribute a qualifying index date.

value_map.FUPDRIVEN: (FUPDRIVEN) Earliest of FUPENDDATE/CDPEND; program will only evaluate for values that have been specified by the user
value_map.DATADRIVEN: (DATADRIVEN) Query-dependent to support fixed risk window analyses
INDENDDATE will be used to explicitly specify date

parameters.name: Follow-up End Date
parameters.info: Last day a patient can contribute follow-up time to the analysis.

parameters.info: Whether to censor patient episodes based on Common Components database completeness date

value_map.N: No, do not censor episodes based on Common Components data completeness date

value_map.0: (0) Reclassify institutional stay, outpatient, emergency department, and other ambulatory encounters that occur during an inpatient stay as inpatient encounters
value_map.1: (1) Reclassify institutional stay, outpatient, emergency department, and other ambulatory encounters that occur during an inpatient stay as inpatient encounters. Do not reclassify if encounter occurs on day of admission

value_map.N: (N) Do not generate or output distribution files [RUNID]_distindex.sas7bdat and [RUNID]_distindexmax.sas7bdat

value_map.A: All (includes patients identified in secondary episodes when conducting a multiple events or overlap analysis, includes patients identified in both primary and secondary cohorts when conducting a concomitant use analysis)
